items.title: Sweden fines Miljödata $183,000 over breach affecting 2.2 million
items.summary: Sweden's data privacy regulator, IMY, has imposed a $183,000 (SEK 1.8 million) fine on IT systems provider Miljödata for inadequate security measures leading to a breach in August 2025 affecting 2.2 million people. [...]

items.title: Relays Are Masking Chinese Access to Frontier AI Models in the US
items.summary: More than 80,000 AI relay servers are helping users in China mask their identities while they access cutting-edge large language models (LLMs), probably to clone them.

items.title: Canadian regulator opens probe of IDScan for allegedly violating data privacy laws
items.summary: The investigation, announced Monday, will probe IDScan’s security practices and whether victim notifications were adequate under Canada’s federal private-sector privacy law, the regulator said in a press release.

items.title: The Truth about GET and HTTP Standards, (Tue, Sep 22nd)
items.summary: On Friday, Xavier talked about the newly introduced HTTP Query method. This new method was introduced to allow "GET" requests that include a body. The main reason for this was that GET requests typically do not contain a body. But what if they do?
